$comment: Engine registry — M0.5 WP7. Source of truth for docs/engines/*. Hand-maintained; generators never write to this file.

engines.name: Room Engine
risks: Room capacity and lifecycle transitions are asserted by server authority rows only; UI-level lifecycle remains unmeasured.

engines.name: Timeline Engine
risks: No certification row targets timeline ordering guarantees.

engines.name: Watch Party Engine
risks: ADR-014 caps this engine at coordinated manual sync for all Tier C providers.

engines.name: Sync Engine
risks: Clock offset resolution is capped at ~1000ms by HTTP Date granularity.

engines.name: Voice Engine
risks: PROF-08 is unsupported: no LiveKit test project is provisioned, so every voice row is blocked.

engines.name: Presence Engine
risks: Ready propagation is measured at transport level only; UI render time is excluded.

engines.name: Provider Engine
risks: Certification registry is empty: every provider resolves to Tier C. Zero Tier A, zero Tier B.

engines.name: Notification Engine
risks: Email deliverability is verified manually against DNS records; no automated row exists.

engines.name: Community Engine
risks: Friend and invite flows have no certification coverage.

engines.name: AI / Po Engine
risks: Po planning behaviour is unmeasured; ADR-001 clarification policy is unverified by test.

engines.name: Analytics Engine
risks: Analytics events are not schema-validated at emission.

engines.name: Experience Subsystem
risks: Automated accessibility sweep covers unnamed controls only; a manual WCAG 2.1 AA audit is still required.
Cross-cutting presentation only — holds no business state or authority.
